properties.description: A beverage company that challenges industry norms by selling mountain water and flavored sparkling drinks in sustainable aluminum cans. Known for its distinctively edgy and provocative marketing, the brand aims to make environmental sustainability accessible and entertaining. By replacing single-use plastic bottles with infinitely recyclable aluminum, it captures a loyal following among younger, eco-conscious demographics. Its product range has expanded from still water to include various flavored carbonated waters, teas, and energy drinks.
